description: Brazilian Portuguese for English speakers: 60 guided one-to-one lessons of 45 minutes (A0 → B2), with English explanations, Brazilian Portuguese practice, homework, and teacher-only material (answer keys, listening scripts, speaking models).
lessonPlan: Let's begin and explanation 5 min · Practice 1 9 min · Review 5 min · Practice 2 10 min · Speaking practice 11 min · Homework explanation 5 min
structureNote: Cada lição tem material do aluno (`student`) e do professor (`teacher`: revisão espaçada, gabaritos, scripts de listening e modelos de fala). O JSON original fica em `source/` e o Tiptap em `lessons/` é gerado por `tools/build_workbooks.py`.
